To count the favorable arrangements:
1. Assign each color to one even and one odd position.

3. The number of ways to arrange the six colors in the six odd positions is \(6!\).

Thus, the number of favorable arrangements is \(6! \times 6!\).

\frac{(6! \times 6!) \times 2^6}{12!}
